title: Omni-Embed-Audio: Leveraging Multimodal LLMs for Robust Audio-Text Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2604.18360v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Audio-text retrieval systems based on Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining (CLAP) achieve strong performance on traditional benchmarks; however, these benchmarks rely on caption-style queries that differ substantially from real-world search behavior, limiting their assessment of practical retrieval robustness. We present Omni-Embed-Audio (OEA), a retrieval-oriented encoder leveraging multimodal LLMs with native audio understanding. To systematically evaluate robustness beyond caption-style queries, we introduce User-Intent Queries (UIQs) - five formulations reflecting natural search behaviors: questions, commands, keyword tags, paraphrases, and exclusion-based negative queries. For negative queries, we develop a hard negative mining pipeline and propose discrimination metrics (HNSR, TFR) assessing models' ability to suppress acoustically similar distractors. translated_title: Omni-Embed-Audio：利用多模态大语言模型实现稳健的音频-文本检索
translated_abstract: 基于对比语言-音频预训练（CLAP）的音频-文本检索系统在传统基准测试中表现优异；然而，这些基准测试依赖于字幕式的查询方式，与真实世界的搜索行为存在很大差异，限制了对实际检索鲁棒性的评估。我们提出了 Omni-Embed-Audio（OEA），一种利用具备原生音频理解能力的多模态大语言模型的面向检索的编码器。为了系统性地评估超越字幕式查询的鲁棒性，我们引入了用户意图查询——五种反映自然搜索行为的查询形式：提问式、命令式、关键词标签式、同义改写式以及基于排除的否定式查询。针对否定式查询，我们开发了难负例挖掘流水线，并提出了判别指标（HNSR、TFR）来评估模型抑制声学相似干扰项的能力。在 AudioCaps、Clotho 和 MECAT 数据集上的实验表明，OEA 取得了……
tldr: 提出了基于多模态大语言模型的音频检索编码器 Omni-Embed-Audio（OEA），并引入五种用户意图查询形式、难负例挖掘流水线及判别指标（HNSR、TFR），以更贴近真实搜索行为的方式评估音频-文本检索的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: Proposes Omni-Embed-Audio (OEA), a retrieval-oriented encoder leveraging multimodal LLMs with native audio understanding, and introduces five User-Intent Query formulations along with a hard negative mining pipeline and discrimination metrics (HNSR, TFR) to more realistically evaluate audio-text retrieval robustness.
